product_summary: A Korean-first short-text feed app. Readers follow strands of interest through a calm, newspaper-rhythm timeline, catch up on threads, and add one thought back into the conversation.
audiences: 출퇴근길에 관심 주제의 짧은 글을 따라잡고 싶은 20-40대 한국어 사용자
알고리즘 피드의 소음 대신 자신이 고른 결(주제 흐름)만 읽고 싶은 사용자
긴 글 대신 짧은 생각을 스레드에 얹는 방식으로 대화하고 싶은 작성자

application_concept.primary_job: 사용자가 자신이 고른 관심 결(strand)의 새 글을 따라잡고, 스레드에 짧은 생각 하나를 얹는다.
application_concept.success_moment: 사용자가 안 읽은 글을 다 따라잡고, 하나의 스레드에 답글이나 인용을 남긴 상태.
differentiation: 타임라인은 카드 벽이 아니라 신문 조판 리듬의 헤어라인 피드다.
피드 상단의 strand 선택이 알고리즘 대신 무엇을 읽을지 결정한다.
이어진 글은 thread spine(세로 연결선)으로 묶여 대화 단위로 읽힌다.
지표는 낚시가 되지 않도록 절제된 메타 텍스트로만 존재한다.

layout_skeleton.composition: single-column reading feed with strand selector and thread spines
layout_skeleton.navigation_model: bottom mode tabs with floating compose action

primary_regions.name: Strand rail
primary_regions.role: 관심 결 선택 — 전체, 디자인, AI, 야구 같은 주제 흐름 전환

primary_regions.name: Reading feed
primary_regions.role: 헤어라인으로 분리된 글 행의 연속. 스레드는 spine으로 묶임

primary_regions.name: Catch-up marker
primary_regions.role: 여기까지 읽음 표시와 새 글 경계

first_screen_contract: 첫 viewport에 strand rail과 글 행 3개 이상이 함께 보여야 함
글 행은 카드 프레임 없이 헤어라인으로만 분리되어야 함
스레드로 이어진 글은 세로 spine으로 시각적으로 묶여야 함
engagement 지표가 본문보다 시각적으로 우세하면 실패
avoid_layouts: post cards with rounded frames and shadows

signature_moves: Strand rail: 알고리즘 탭 대신 사용자가 고른 주제 결로 피드를 전환한다.
Thread spine: 이어진 대화를 세로 연결선으로 묶어 한 단위로 읽게 한다.
Catch-up marker: '여기까지 읽음' 경계가 피드의 시간 감각을 만든다.
Typographic feed: 아바타보다 본문 타이포그래피가 행의 주인공이다.
repetition_risks: 글 행을 라운드 카드로 감싸는 것
지표 아이콘 행이 본문만큼 커지는 것
strand rail이 generic filter chip row처럼 보이는 것

component_decision.rationale: Gyeol is a reading instrument: a strand selector, a hairline text feed with thread spines, and one compose action. Rounded post cards, trending grids, and stories rows are excluded so the timeline stays typographic and calm.

core_components.name: app-shell
core_components.role: Constrains the mobile reading column and fixed thumb-zone controls.
core_components.decision_reason: The feed needs a phone-scale reading column, not a dashboard shell.

core_components.name: feed-topline
core_components.role: Brand mark, account avatar, search entry.
core_components.decision_reason: The topline orients without becoming a marketing header.

core_components.name: strand-rail
core_components.role: Horizontal strand selector that switches the feed's topic flow.
core_components.decision_reason: User-chosen strands replace algorithmic tabs as the core control.

core_components.name: strand-token
core_components.role: One selectable strand with unread count.
core_components.decision_reason: Strands must read as reading destinations, not filter chips.

core_components.name: post-row
core_components.role: One post: author line, body text, restrained meta row.
core_components.decision_reason: Hairline rows keep the timeline typographic instead of a card wall.

core_components.name: thread-spine
core_components.role: Vertical line binding consecutive posts of one conversation.
core_components.decision_reason: Threads should be read as one unit without card nesting.

core_components.name: quote-block
core_components.role: Compact embedded reference to another post inside a post body.
core_components.decision_reason: Quotes need containment without turning the row into a card stack.

core_components.name: inline-media
core_components.role: Edge-to-edge image attachment inside a post row.
core_components.decision_reason: Media supports the text; it must not become a gallery card.

core_components.name: action-meta-row
core_components.role: Reply, repost, save actions as quiet meta text and small icons.
core_components.decision_reason: Metrics stay subordinate to the body text to avoid engagement bait.

core_components.name: catch-up-marker
core_components.role: Boundary line showing where the reader left off.
core_components.decision_reason: The reading job needs a visible sense of progress.

core_components.name: new-posts-pill
core_components.role: Floating notice that new posts arrived above.
core_components.decision_reason: Arrival should be announced without auto-scrolling the reader.

core_components.name: compose-action
core_components.role: Fixed thumb-zone entry into writing one thought.
core_components.decision_reason: Writing is the one creation action and stays reachable.

core_components.name: bottom-mode-tabs
core_components.role: Switches between feed, threads, alerts, and profile modes.
core_components.decision_reason: Mode navigation belongs at the bottom for one-handed use.

rejected_components.name: post-card
rejected_components.reason: Rounded card frames break the newspaper rhythm and re-create the generic feed.

rejected_components.name: trending-card-grid
rejected_components.reason: Trends belong in a quiet list, not a marketing grid.

rejected_components.name: stories-row
rejected_components.reason: Ephemeral media circles contradict the reading-first promise.

rejected_components.name: engagement-counter-bar
rejected_components.reason: Large metric bars turn reading into scorekeeping.

rejected_components.name: modal-composer
rejected_components.reason: Composing opens as a focused surface, not an interruptive modal in the mock.

notes: Chrome stays achromatic; the single restrained accent must NOT be blue (anti twitter-clone).
Avatars and inline media carry the color.
